leave.desc_msg:
Are you sure you want me to leave? Please choose an option below.
- **Leave** - I'll leave the server but keep the settings except for my webhooks log channel, in case if you change your mind.
- **Leave and forget** - I will wipe this server from the my databases completely and will need to be reconfigured if you invite me back.
- **Cancel** - abort the process.

leave.label: Leave

purge.label: Leave and forget
purge.title: {name} left and wiped all data
purge.desc: I hope I was helpful while it lasted! All data about your server was removed from my database, so you don't have to worry about your privacy. In case if you change your mind, you can still get me working again, although it may require some reconfiguration.

cancel.desc: All operations aborted, I will stay in your server. Thank you for your trust!

privacy.title: Anastellos Engine Example Privacy Policy
privacy.desc:
> __This Privacy Policy serves as a placeholder. Please ensure you review and amend this document as necessary before using it.__
This Privacy Policy (“Policy”) applies solely to the use of the Bot hosted by the account identified as `<@your_bot_id>` (“Bot”) and outlines the practices regarding the processing and storage of certain user data (“Data”) when using the Bot in a Discord server (“Guild”).

*By pressing the "Agree" button, you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, the Bot will automatically leave the guild.*
### 1. **Data Processing**
The Bot processes specific data necessary for its operation as follows:
- **Guild Identification**: Upon invitation to a guild, the Bot logs the guild ID and guild name.
- **User Interactions**: The Bot may log the IDs and usernames of users who:
  - Issue commands in channels accessible by the Bot,
  - Send direct messages to the Bot, or
  - Mention the Bot in any accessible channel.
- **Operational Data Caching**: To function correctly, the Bot may temporarily process and/or cache various data, including (but not limited to) message IDs, content, attachments, member IDs, usernames, guild nicknames, avatar URLs, and custom statuses. Although this Data is processed for Bot functionality, it is not directly accessible by the developer.
### 2. **Data Storage**
- **Diagnostic Logging**: The Bot saves logged Data in text files for diagnostic purposes.
- **Conditional User Data Storage**: The Bot does not store personal Data unless the account owner provides explicit consent. This is typically for purposes such as recognition of contributions to the Bot’s development or translation.
- **Guild Configuration**: Once an authorized Guild member accepts this Privacy Policy, the Bot records the guild ID in a local database to store guild settings. This includes various configuration preferences such as command prefix, language, technical channel IDs, and similar settings.
### 3. **Access to Data**
Data collected and stored by the Bot resides on a secure cloud server managed exclusively by the developer. The developer is the sole individual with access to and authority over this Data.
### 4. **Data Removal**
- **Guild Data Removal**: To remove guild-specific preferences and IDs from the Bot's database, users can initiate the "Leave and forget" option by using the command `ae!leave`.
- **User Data Removal**: Users who previously consented to data storage can request deletion of their information. Such requests must be submitted directly to the developer, either through direct message or the support Discord server.

> **Policy Modifications**: The developer reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time, with or without prior notice to users.
